backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing hubs, posts, predictions, fixtures, team assets, player ratings, feature section data, and an auto-refreshing news ticker using ordered maps and timers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three publish‑help related features to their source files, involved components, and requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing routing, pages, components, styling, and new publish‑help integrations.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML root file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all app routes including the new /publish-help page within a themed layout.
frontend/src/components/AuthDialog.tsx: Authentication dialog allowing guest or registered user creation with avatar selection and toastr feedback.
frontend/src/components/EmojiPicker.tsx: Popover emoji picker component with categorized emoji groups and selection callback.
frontend/src/components/HighlightsTab.ts: Manages uploading, displaying, and voting on image highlights with localStorage persistence and weekly top-highlights compilation.
frontend/src/components/NewsTickerBar.ts: Displays an auto-scrolling news ticker with duplicated headlines and a refresh action, styled based on the saved team.
frontend/src/components/PlayerRating.tsx: Provides a 1–5 star rating UI for players, storing user ratings locally and syncing with backend rating APIs.
frontend/src/components/PointsTracker.ts: Shows the user’s points and tier based on localStorage and opens a dialog with tier details and point breakdown.
frontend/src/components/SharedHubModal.t: Modal prompting users to join a hub as guest or registered user, with optional remembered auth preference.
frontend/src/components/ShareToSocial.ts: Toggles simulated social sharing of a comment and records share history in localStorage.
Displays recently shared comment activity from localStorage with platform icons and scrolling view.
frontend/src/components/TeamOfTheWeekBui: UI component allowing users to select up to 11 players, generate a Team of the Week, and save it to localStorage.
frontend/src/components/TeamVisualTempla: Displays team visuals using predefined logos and key player data based on team name.
frontend/src/components/UserProfile.tsx: User profile dropdown enabling hub invite link generation, logout handling, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, identity persistence, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for hubs, dashboard data, team data, posts, and predictions with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global fonts, Tailwind layers, light/dark theme CSS variables, animations, and custom title styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity context and mounts App.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseHubs.tsx: Displays a list of popular teams and lets users select one to create or switch their hub.
frontend/src/pages/ChatInterface.tsx: Implements an AI-style chat interface for adding content to a user's hub with team and sport selection flows.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main team dashboard with posts, predictions, fixtures, news, and interactive UI utilities.
frontend/src/pages/FanCommunityPage.tsx: Shows a community feed for a selected team and allows users to post comments.
frontend/src/pages/FanLeaderboardPage.ts: Renders a fan leaderboard with generated demo data, tier icons, and a weekly summary section. Includes navigation back home and sorted leaderboard display.
frontend/src/pages/FanPredictionsPage.ts: Allows users to select or enter a team, view AI-powered prediction content, and submit predictions. Integrates query hooks, posting logic, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/IntroScreen.tsx: Empty file with no implemented component.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Handles authentication prompts, shared hub entry, and routing logic based on URL params. Displays landing UI with dialogs and user session handling.
frontend/src/pages/LiveFixturesPage.tsx: Lets users pick a team to view upcoming fixtures and post comments. Includes fixture parsing logic, query hooks, and UI for navigating and posting.
frontend/src/pages/PublishHelpPage.tsx: Displays instructions for publishing the app live, explaining draft vs live behavior. Provides navigation controls and step-by-step guidance.
frontend/src/pages/TeamNewsPage.tsx: A React page that lets users select or enter a team and then fetches and displays related news using a query hook. Includes predefined team lists, navigation, and UI for showing results once a team is chosen.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, shadows, animations, and container settings. Loads typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing issues with missing publish functionality and defining related feature requests. Includes version info, architectural notes, and pending requirements.
